title: Content fragments (DAM) → EDS fragment documents
status: partly REOPENED 2026-10-27 — see component-map.json row contentFragment and open-questions.md
decisions: approved: every content fragment used inside an XF becomes its own fragment document at cfToFragmentPath() (/us/en/fragments/content-fragments/...), referenced by the XF fragment that contains it.
approved: each document keeps ALL the fragment's fields (from .migration/cf-content; all 55 exported, one model: contact-us-information-fragment-model).

reopened.why: The approval assumed only 2 fragments show a subset of their fields. Checked against the export: 60 of 71 uses (45 of 55 fragments) hide fields that hold values (mostly phones, emails, addresses) and no use shows the *Label fields. Showing all fields would add content the live pages do not show.
reopened.proposal: Cards (contact) card with the fields the live page shows; the other fields and the labels kept in the same document as metadata rows (stored, not rendered). The 2 fragments shown with different field sets (global-headquarters, latin-america primary-contact) show the union of both.

pending: user decision on the reopened point
